programme.desc: The owner of a local gym in Sparta tries to protect her delinquent brother, who is falsely accused of murder.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: It's Christmastime and an eager journalist from the local newspaper begs to interview the police force.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Gillespie and Tibbs investigate a fatal car crash and medical reports show the driver may have been poisoned.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Will time run out for a death row prisoner as the Sparta police attempt to save his life?

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: When a local boy dies of an overdose, Gillespie wants a high schooler charged with murder.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Sparta Police investigate a suspicious car crash and discover connections to a fraudulent development plan.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: A blind woman witnesses the murder of her neighbor. But her life may be in danger too.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: A student is the only witness to the rape of his teacher, but his father refuses to allow him to get involved.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Bubba Skinner goes to Los Angeles to take custody of a suspected arsonist and bring him back to Sparta.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: The ex-husband of Harriet DeLong has been charged with murder and is facing a death sentence.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: A young witness is reluctant to come forward after a double murder at a local roadhouse.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: An old flame of Gillespie's reappears in Sparta with her daughter, the product of the affair that they had.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Bubba gets involved when his cousin and her husband are blackmailed by the birth father of their adopted baby.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: A teacher in Sparta with her multiple romances attracts negative attention from the townsfolk.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: The fun and games come to a halt when the wealthy host of an annual high-stakes poker party is murdered.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Bubba finds himself in trouble when he is in involved in an accidental shooting while on the job.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Bubba Skinner returns to Los Angeles to tie up some unfinished business on an arson case.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Money and a secret love affair drive a businessman to stop at nothing to bring his partner down.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Brilliant geneticist Martin Nodel (Ron Rifkin) unlocks a secret code imprinted on human DNA. But when he tests this code on himself, his "instincts" draw him to a remote location where he finds a trip...to The Outer Limits. Ryan Reynolds co-stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When it is not known if aliens headed to Earth are friend or foe, five people are placed in secret bunkers to man switches that, if not pressed at specified intervals, will set off mass destruction that will destroy everything, alien or human alike.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Engaged as soldiers on a distant planet to prevent a race of alien bugs from stealing minerals that provide the Earth's energy, a woman (Christine Elise) and her troops accidentally discover that the real enemy may not be the aliens at all.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a seemingly harmless audio signal from space causes physiological changes in Earth's youth, a young scientist races against time to discover what exactly is happening and why. Could the changes be necessary for the survival of the planet?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A despondent man finds himself torn between killing himself and killing his co-workers. Before he can do either, he's pulled into The Outer Limits where there are hundreds of versions of him, each with a different life and a different character.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A woman's life changes dramatically when she accidentally shoots herself in the head which causes her to not only grow more intelligent, but also to realize how dull her life was before the photo in a picture frame started talking to her.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When an incident at a space station leaves three people dead, the captain of the ship returns to Earth to face murder charges. Is the captain a murderous madman? Or has he actually seen the face of evil floating in the zero-gravity of deep space?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The residents of a suburban neighborhood have their lives turned upside down when a four block section of their subdivision is ripped from the earth by a mysterious force and transported to a distant planet. David McCallum and Laura Harris star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Muckraking TV journalist Donald Rivers (Alan Thicke), host of "The Whole Truth," has the show of a lifetime: rock solid-proof that the government and private defense contractors have been engaging in secret genetic cloning.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Using an experimental treatment, a scientist (Pat Morita) helps an aging athlete (Adrian Pasdar) end his career on a high note by accelerating his reflexes for one last match. But with victory comes side-effects...courtesy of The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: In a society controlled by aliens, a mother rebels when she is forced to give up her child to Mother, a wise alien who acts as a parent to all infants. Determined to get the child back, she embarks upon a dangerous quest that will change her world.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When Genetic Engineering creates super-babies, some suffer from Genetic Rejection Syndrome (GRS), making them stronger and more deadly. A detective (Gary Cole) must stop his GRS son, a suspected killer, but must take a serum to become more like him.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Hunters pay to hunt androids that have a chip that keeps them from harming humans. However, secretly planted data allows the androids to disable the chip, and the balance of power shifts between men and machines! Starring Ron White and Doug Savant.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Xenobiologist Teresa Janovitch (Melissa Gilbert) is on a military team searching an uninhabited planet for minerals. When the team is attacked by aliens and a retaliation is successful, Janovitch makes a shocking discovery about the victims.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Reporter Judy Warren (Kate Vernon) tracks down Josh (Alex McArthur), a recluse who performs miracles. Alien or angel? All that Judy knows is that now the military is involved and she doesn't trust them. If she can help Josh, will she find the truth?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A medical specialist (Peter Flemming) examines a case involving an epidemic that killed a number of children in a small town. Through hypnosis, he probes the mind of a surviving child (Rachel Leigh Cook) and unravels a memory of "alien" proportions.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: As part of a top-secret program, the brain content of a military Captain (Lou Diamond Phillips) is temporarily transferred to an android to create a superior soldier. But, when things go wrong, can the transfer be reversed? Also starring Robert Joy.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A group of hospital patients and their nurse, Marie Alexander (Maria Conchita Alonso), survive a global, terrorist bio-attack. A vaccine arrives, but there are only three doses. Who will be chosen? Will it be survival of the fittest?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Bernard (Ayre Gross) is haunted by images from his past and the tragic death of his sister...a death he caused. An experimental treatment brings positive results, but also a dangerous side effect: Bernard can now transfer his fear to others!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a transport ship Captain (C. Thomas Howell) is rescued after surviving a devastating crash on Venus, strange things begin to happen when he returns to Earth. He did what it took to survive on Venus, but could the price of survival be too high?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A scientist (Gregory Harrison) in a colony on another planet urges evacuation when he discovers that a radioactive star will soon pass over. He has been wrong before, though, and at great cost. Will the truth be accepted in time to save the colony?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Charlie Bouton (Tom Butler) and Melburn Ross (Michael Shanks) create Mary 25, a nanny robot. When Bouton falls in love with Mary and mistreats his wife, a woman whom Ross once loved, the lines between human and machine become dangerously blurred.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A negotiator (Brett Cullen) tries to find out why a grad student (Peter Stebbings) is threatening to detonate a deadly, self-made bomb, unless the government kills five people for him. Why those five people? Is it revenge? And can he be stopped?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Four telekinetic people are recruited by the CIA, who hopes to use their talents to assassinate a war criminal. Their powers produce unexpected side-effects; however, and the killers may soon find that they are the prey. Robert Guillaume stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When Dr. Nodel (Ron Rifkin) is joined on an alien ship by a small group of students to communicate with aliens, it appears that they've all been led into a trap. Have the aliens led them astray? Ryan Reynolds also stars. Sequel to "Double Helix"

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A battle cruiser is captured by the enemy Ebonites on planet N-1-8-4. Imprisoned, the crew is interrogated by The Voice, an unseen Ebonite. Who will be the first to snap? And what will happen then? Starring Maurice Dean Wint and Steven Bauer.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: In the world of 2055, men are extinct. Preserved by cryonics, a man (David Keith) awakens in Lithia, a poor matriarchy. He's welcomed, but when he upsets the natural order of things, the question arises: Can the world men be revived? And should it?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When two archeologists (Lisa Zane, David Cubitt) discover a cocooned alien that suddenly begins to reanimate, the rest of the research team turns greedy, wanting to cash in on it. When the couple refuses, they find themselves numbered...or are they?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An alien (Rene Auberjonois) and his family live on a secure farm on Earth, where they grow their own food. Most of the aliens believe that the human race was wiped out in the war, but there is a group of humans in the woods...and they are starving!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A doctor (Maurice Godin) creates a controversial process to reverse aging and disease. So, when an older woman (Barbara Rush) he loves is close to death, he knows he can save her. But there is always a price to be paid...in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: On Mars, the Free Alliance and the Coalition of Middle-Eastern and Pacific States mine minerals under a truce until an apparent attack on Earth. Without clear evidence of war, is retaliation wise, or hasty? Barbara Eve Harris and Adam Baldwin star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A former soldier (Ron Perlman) has horrifying flashbacks from his days as a member of a covert branch of the military. But when flashback star to become reality, he wonders whether he is insane...or if there a new covert mission afoot.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Mac 27 (Nicolas Lea) is Innobotics' newest android. He's emotionless, but he escapes after a glitch and takes a hostage, Celia (Nana Visitor). She sees human qualities in Mac and tries to convince him that he has feelings. But why help her captor?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Joe Pantoliano stars as a shock-jock whose specialty is ridiculing UFO believers. But when a true Believer sets himself on fire in front of Stan, the D.J. finds the very foundation of his disbelief beginning to crumble. Cynthia Nixon also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a cancer-ridden doctor (Robert Hayes) is given a full-body transplant, he soon develops disturbing visions of a life he never led, of loves he's never experienced... and of a shocking, brutal murder. Wendel Meldrum and Thomas Cavanaugh also star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A brilliant inventor (Ralph Waite) who murdered a man who stole credit for his work, is double crossed by the other inmates in jail when they discover his "small friends" -- microscopic machines --can seve just about any purposeï¿½including jailbreak.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The Grell had come to earth not as equals, but as slaves. Now, an uprising has gripped the world in fear, and a high-ranking government official (Ted Shackelford), who is lost in Grell territory, experiences firsthand the ugly face of racism.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Dr. Eberhardt (Ralph Macchio) discovers a way for comatose patients to communicate with each other by interfacing with a computer. But when he hooks himself up to the machine, he discovers a cyberspace "paradise" he may never be able to leave!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Cliff Robertson -- who starred in the very first episode of the classic series -- returns to the Outer Limits as an aging astronaut whose 1963 mission was a career-ending disaster. If he can just get back to space, perhaps he can clear his name.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Like other Star Fleet vessels, Ship (voice of Malcolm McDowell) has evolved and now controls the only human (Jack Noseworthy) aboard. But the relationship takes a dramatic turn when Man meets Woman and fights machine in a desperate bid for freedom!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Do our memories define our identity? If we are merely the sum of our experiences, what do we become if those experiences are lost? Hope Wilson (Robbie Chong) faces this question when she meets a man who has purposely erased his own memories.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Courtesy of a freak accident (and The Outer Limits), an agoraphobe (Jane Adams) begins to hear the private thoughts of all of the tenants in her building...the good, the bad and the steamy. And it seems at least one of them may want to kill her.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A scientist -- who is also a religious zealot (David Ogden Stiers) -- secretly implants an embryo created with DNA from the Shroud of Turin into a young woman (Samantha Mathis) in order to scientifically engineer the Second Coming of Christ.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The Outer Limits come to Victorian Whitechapel when a London doctor (Cary Elwes) races to capture the alien creature responsible for the Jack the Ripper murders. But when the alien frames the good doctor for the murders, his time may be up.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The son (Saul Rubinek) of a concentration camp survivor (Peter Boretski) gets some unique help in proving the guilt of a former Nazi (Jan Rubes) living in the U.S....courtesy of a time traveler (Alex Daikun) and, of course, The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The planets Earth and Dregocia struggle to re-establish a fragile trust after a summit goes tragically wrong. Can a diplomat (Marcia Cross) calm the hawkish nature of both species...and can she overcome her own prejudices to save both worlds?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A meek anthropologist (Leland Orser) develops a serum for genetic dominance and tests it on himself. Now his newfound confidence takes complete control of him, turning him into an irrational, overly aggressive troglodyte! Can he reverse the process?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The Haven is a high-tech apartment building which is run by supercomputer and almost completely eliminates the need for human contact. But when things begin to go wrong, neighbors who have never met must learn to work together in order to survive!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a scientist's (Kevin Nealon) experiment unintentionally creates a rift in the space-time continuum, he suddenly find himself caught in a time loop and soon begins to suspects sabotage. Terri Hawkes, Jennifer Copping and Ronny Cox also star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A boy (Adam Hann-Byrd) , picked on by high-school bullies and neglected by his own father (Daniel Hugh Kelley), finds comfort in an alien (Chris Potter) who has crash-landed on earth. But is the alien what he claims to be? Never...in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: In a world dominated by alien invaders, a cynical American cafe owner (Nathan Fillion) must decide if he will risk his life to help an old lover fight for Earth or if he is happy not rocking the political boat. Derek de Lint also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When Detective Terry Russo (Megan Gallagher) is called to investigate a double murder, she discovers she may be solving not one crime, but possibly hundreds. And that the culprit -- or culprits -- may not be human at all. Michael Riley also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A convicted murderer is turned loose only to be hunted by the sister of his victim as part the hottest show on television, Judgment Day, which allows the family members -- and the at home audience -- to act as judge, jury and executioner!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An ex-con who had been serving time for spousal abuse is bent on revenge against his wife. He purchases a strange handgun from a gun dealer and finds this is no ordinary weapon and, in fact, he becomes quite attached to it...literally.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A device that allows people to change their appearance helps a nerdy guy become the mirror image of his hunky co-worker.. Now arrogant with his new-found good looks, the former nerd experiences a life like never before...and now he wants to keep it.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An invisible alien race that inhabits the energy systems of a deserted spaceship envelopes the crew of a salvage team, responding to the empty vessel's distress signal, in a web of paranoia, suspicion and murder. Michael Shanks stars.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.desc: Una vecina le entrega a Ludovico unos cachorros, pues cree que son hijos de su perro. Ludovico le ordena a Ludoviquito que venda a los perritos. Junior recupera la memoria y cree que ha sido secuestrado por una peligrosa banda.

programme.title: 40 y 20
programme.desc: Paco recibe la visita de Merlina, una exalumna que se divorció porque está enamorada de él, y quiere formar una familia.

programme.title: 40 y 20
programme.desc: Fran se une a Los Cascabelillos, una banda de rock indie alternativo. Cuando quieren ensayar en el departamento, Paco se enoja, aunque luego cambiará la opinión.

programme.title: Vecinos
programme.desc: Frankie recibe la llamada de un productor que quiere filmar la segunda parte de "La toalla del mojado", pero le pide su apoyo económico. Luis le advierte a Frankie que no debe dar dinero antes de firmar un contrato, pero él lo ignora.

programme.title: Vecinos
programme.desc: Frankie y Lorena le piden a Silvia que ayude a Benito a estudiar, pues necesita mejorar en la escuela; Silvia le hace una prueba a Benito para ver por qué no pone atención y se sorprende porque cree que está enamorado de ella.
programme.sub-title: Primer amor... Benito a mil por hora

programme.title: Nosotros los guapos
programme.desc: Doña Cuca les consigue trabajo a Vítor y a Albertano en la panadería de la colonia; Vítor descubre su talento para preparar bolillos con su ingrediente secreto, mientras que Albertano vive un amor frustrado con la hija del panadero.
programme.sub-title: Con el sudor de mi frente

programme.title: Nosotros los guapos
programme.desc: Albertano descubre que tiene un talento especial para calmar a los perros y convence a Vítor para que ambos entren a trabajar a una veterinaria.

programme.title: Los héroes del norte
programme.desc: El escándalo sobre la paternidad de Zacarías se ha vuelto el único tema en los programas de chismes. La banda ha arrasado con todos los premios: Grupo Revelación, Mejor Disco del Año, Mejor Video, Mejor Canción del Año y Mejor Grupo Norteño.

programme.title: Los héroes del norte
programme.desc: Don Pascacio amenaza a los Héroes con publicar las fotos si no recibe una importante suma de dinero. Mientras tanto, Prisca toma la decisión de abandonar a Hassan para siempre.

programme.title: Los héroes del norte
programme.desc: Escándalo alrededor de los Héroes del Norte acerca de un antro gay. En medio de chismes y amenazas, Doña Olegaria suspende todas las actividades de la banda, que regresa a la mansión y se encuentra con que deben declarar Hacienda urgente.

programme.title: Los héroes del norte
programme.desc: Los Héroes hacen un último concierto para cerrar la deuda que tienen con la Hacienda.

programme.title: Los héroes del norte
programme.desc: Zacarías asiste al funeral de la banda, mientras el país llora la pérdida. Los Héroes, mientas tanto, creen que son fantasmas y visitan sus propias tumbas.

programme.title: Nosotros los guapos
programme.desc: Albertano lleva al Vítor a trabajar con él de mesero a una fiesta para solteros. El Vítor se mete en problemas porque trata de seducir a una de las mujeres en la fiesta. Albertano y el Vítor animan la fiesta bailando con todos los asistentes.

programme.title: Nosotros los guapos
programme.desc: El Vítor y Albertano van a las oficinas de un partido político para pedir trabajo de diputados, senadores o gobernadores. Albertano y el Vítor se inscriben a las elecciones para ganar el puesto de jefe de manzana y luego fundan sus propios partidos.

programme.title: Nosotros los guapos
programme.desc: El Vítor y Albertano le cuentan a Rosita y doña Cuca que trabajarán de guardaespaldas de Ninel Conde, pero ellas no creen que duren en ese trabajo y hacen una apuesta. Ninel les dice al Vítor y Albertano las reglas para poder trabajar con ella.

programme.title: Nosotros los guapos
programme.desc: En su constante búsqueda por ganar dinero y pagarle a Doña Cuca la renta, Vítor y Albertano se emplean en una funeraria. Entre errores y enredos, se darán cuenta de que lo peor que le puede pasar a una persona no es la muerte.

programme.title: Nosotros los guapos
programme.desc: Vítor convence a Albertano de acudir al gimnasio para ponerse en forma, sin imaginar que esto le dará la oportunidad de trabajar en un show solo para mujeres, pero desesperadas.

programme.title: Vecinos
programme.desc: Luis descubre que es el cumple de Silvia, y planea darle un regalo sorpresa. Morris ha desaparecido y nadie sabe dónde se metió.

programme.title: Vecinos
programme.desc: Luis se ha quedado sin trabajo, por lo que buscará una nueva actividad para invitar a Silvia a salir. Por otro lado, Luismi ha llegado solo al edificio.

programme.title: Vecinos
programme.desc: Pedro consigue una cita doble, para él y para Luis con dos chicas. Germán es el elegido para resolver el problema de vialidad afuera del edificio.

programme.title: Vecinos
programme.desc: Silvia rechaza la invitación de Luis de salir a comer. Mientras tanto, Magdalena y Arturo no pueden dormir por culpa del alumbrado público.

programme.title: Vecinos
programme.desc: Luis invita a Silvia a ver una película a su casa, pero Pedro interrumpirá su romántico momento, pues quiere recuperar su tele. Por otra parte, Arturo jugará póker con Germán, Jorjais y Benito.

programme.title: La familia P. Luche
programme.desc: Excelsa le pide a Federica que le preste a su familia, pues sus padres la visitarán y ellos creen que tiene un esposo millonario. La madre de Excelsa cree que Ludovico la engaña.

programme.title: La familia P. Luche
programme.desc: Federica le pide a Ludovico que vayan a comer con sus papas, pero él se niega. Flavio le dice a Ludovico que ha quemado su cartucho de esposo y cuando Federica le pida algo él tendrá que complacerla.

programme.title: La familia P. Luche
programme.desc: Federica quiere inscribirse al club campestre Peluche porque una amiga de ella es miembro, pero son rechazados. Federica y Ludovico toman el expediente de una familia árabe para poder entrar.

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Sebastián, Rodrigo y sus amigos suben videos en la red en los cuales se caen de forma graciosa. Pero Sebastián sufre un accidente y los amigos cambian su forma de pensar.
programme.sub-title: El que riendo la hace, llorando la paga

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta acusa a Pilar de mentirosa. Roberta y Alma discuten por Mía. León necesita el lugar donde tocará RBD para su campaña. Gastón le dice a Mía que Miguel quiere vengarse de su papá porque cree que es responsable de la muerte de su padre.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Diego está dispuesto a enfrentar a su papá por Roberta y la banda. Gastón le informa a Mía que escuchó a Celina vomitando. Roberta decide quedarse con Simón y no perdonar a Diego. Franco le regala a Miguel una casa para su familia y un cheque.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía habla con Celina para pedir ayuda profesional para el problema de bulimia de la segunda. Los alumnos hacen un motín para que Madariaga les explique el porqué se va a ir del colegio. Miguel confía en que Franco no crea lo que le diga Gastón.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Madariaga les miente a los alumnos para que no pierdan el año escolar. León le dice a Gandía que en el colegio existe una banda llamada RBD. Diego hará lo que sea para que Roberta descubra que Simón la engaña.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta cree que Diego inventó que Simón es casado y que delatará a RBD con Gandía. Madariaga prefiere que sus alumnos estén enojados que tristes por él.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Gandía les advierte a los alumnos que serán expulsados del colegio los integrantes RBD. Franco le dice a Mía que fue Carlo quien provocó que quedará en la ruina y muriera el papá de Miguel. Luego, Franco acepta que Gastón proteja a Mía de Miguel.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Franco le dice a Carlo que pagará por estafar al papá de Miguel y es detenido. Luego, Franco abofetea a Miguel y le recrimina que haya traicionado su confianza. Gastón le dice a Miguel que su papá no murió en un accidente sino que se suicidó.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Pilar cree que su papá tiene una relación con Alicia. Nico les dice a todos que Miguel piensa regresar a Monterrey. Alma graba una conversación donde Valeria acepta que odia a Mía. Celina se molesta con Mía y Vico por llevarla con una psicóloga.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Alma no puede comprobar que Valeria odia a Mía, y Franco se enfurece porque habla mal de ella. Franco le dice a Mía que se casará con Valeria. Gastón humilla y golpea a Miguel y Roberta lo defiende.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta le reclama a Gastón que, por su culpa, José se fue. Miguel y Diego evitan que Gastón golpee a Roberta. Monserrat le pide a Roberta que deje a Simón por el bien de su bebé. Pascual castiga a Roberta y la encierra.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Elena le dice a Miguel que su papá sabía que sus negocios eran riesgosos y que, después de irse a la quiebra, sufría fuertes depresiones. Peter le pide a Mía que acompañe a su papá en su boda. Alma y Mía llegan a la boda de Franco.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Ante el Juez, Valeria le dice a Franco que no se casará con él porque solo quería humillarlo. Miguel decide quedarse. Nico le pregunta a Lupita si se casaría con él.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Nico y Lupita están decididos a casarse. José descubre que Gastón informó a León sobre el concierto de RBD. Renata besa a Enrique por celos. Mía accede a tenderle una trampa a Gastón. Pascual les exige que renuncien al grupo o serán expulsados.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Franco está de acuerdo en firmar la carta para desintegrar a RBD. León quiere obligar a Diego a ser Político. Gandía le enseña a Gastón una foto besando a Mía, y él le exige a Mía que le diga por qué lo traicionó diciendo que la obligó a besarlo.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Miguel se pelea a golpes con Gastón por defender a Mía. Ella le pregunta a Miguel si es posible que vuelvan a estar juntos. Diego interroga a Roberta sobre su relación con Simón. Todos los alumnos celebran la boda simbólica de Lupita y Nico.
programme.sub-title: El amor es lo más importante

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Diego quiere ser amigo de Roberta; Miguel le pide perdón a Mía; Mayra convencerá a Lupita y Nico para que no dejen el colegio; Mía le ofrece a Roberta viajar a Orlando con ella y luego a Sudamérica; Diego se preocupa al ver a sus padres discutir.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mabel le recuerda a Diego que lo ama; Madariaga les dice a sus alumnos que los niños de Chiapas lo necesitan; el señor Mendiola le exige a Gandía que reincorpore a Gastón de prefecto; Mía descubre que Roberta cambió su boleto por un viaje en crucero.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Los chicos se divierten en Cuernavaca. Mía y Miguel pasan sus vacaciones juntos y se enteran de que han ganado un viaje. Tras despedirse de Nico en el aeropuerto, Lupita visita a su padre para conocer a su media hermana.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Lola rechaza a Lupita. Diego es picado por una araña gracias a Roberta que está decidida a arruinarle el día. Lupita se entera de que Dulce es también su media hermana. Mía y Miguel se van de viaje.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía hizo arreglos para tener habitaciones separadas de Miguel. Roberta le cuenta a Diego que terminó su relación con Simón. Giovanni se entera de que sus padres sufrieron un desfalco y quedaron en la ruina. Diego encuentra a León con otra mujer.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Empieza el nuevo ciclo escolar y ahora los alumnos tendrán que adaptarse a las nuevas reglas. Algunos cambios son demasiado para ellos. Roberta, indignada, comienza una huelga.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Gandía le advierte a Alma que no va a tolerar más indisciplinas de Roberta; Lisette encuentra a Giovanni en su casa; Roberta le dice a Lupita que Pilar otra vez las traicionó; Mendiola le dice a Gandía que cursará su maestría por Internet.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: La profesora Hilda les informa a los alumnos que Hilario murió el mismo día que se casaron. Vico encuentra a Giovanni en la recámara de Florencia, su mamá. Miguel intenta seducir a Mía, pero lo rechaza.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Miguel le da una sorpresa a Mía y la lleva a una playa encantada lejos de todos, para poder pasar tiempo a solas.
programme.sub-title: Atrapados en la Isla del Amor

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía y Miguel descubren que la lancha no está. Mía tiene miedo de que Miguel la deje como lo hizo su mamá. Lupita y Teo serán los asistentes del profesor de Matemáticas. Castigan a Lupita por culpa de Lola.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía y Miguel se pierden en una playa virgen, y no hay nadie quien los pueda rescatar. El padre de Diego trata de convencerlo para que declare en contra de su madre en el divorcio.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roger le pide a Roberta un concierto. Diego cree que Roberta aún lo quiere, pero Tomás lo desanima. Roberta piensa darle la oportunidad a Diego de demostrarle que ha madurado.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Miguel intenta que Mía reaccione y busca la manera de salir de la isla; Don Cosme abofetea a Giovanni por renegar de ser pobre; Roberta besa a Roger y Diego le dice que Verónica ya es su novia; Miguel encuentra una lancha y al regresar Mía no está.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Miguel le promete a Mía no dejarla sola nunca más; Franco cree que Alma y Guillermo tuvieron relaciones sexuales; Leonardo le demuestra su apoyo a Celina al verla deprimida por la trampa del video; Gandía castiga injustamente a los alumnos.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Leonardo golpea a Rocco por defender a Celina. Gandía piensa que el busto que le regalaron los alumnos contiene una bomba.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía tiene un altercado con Sol, por adueñarse de su cuarto; Pilar le hace creer a Vico que Giovanni la engaña; Franco cree que Mía tuvo relaciones; Leonardo intenta que Lola quiera a Lupita; la banda RBD se reúne para acordar en dónde ensayarán.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía se enfurece al ver que Sol coquetea con Miguel. El Sr. Mendiola le avisa a Gandía que está despedido. Lola no acepta hablar con Lupita. Gandía le avisa a Pilar que la sacará del colegio porque ya no podrá pagarlo.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Pascual anuncia su despido de la institución, todos lloran y no saben si decir la verdad para defenderlo ante el comité para que lo perdonen.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía se enoja al ver llegar a Sol y a su amiga a los ensayos de RBD. El enojo la hizo decidir terminar con el grupo. Llega el nuevo director.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: El nuevo director quiere que se lo respete y que mejor que ponerse contra los alumnos e imponerse cortándole el cabello a Santos, lo que hace que todos lo odien aún más.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía dona parte de su ropa a los niños pobres, pero el director Font aprovecha su generosidad para quedar bien. Mía descubre que Sol y Miguel provocaron que regalara su ropa nueva. León obliga a Diego a firmar una acusación en contra de su madre.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Lola saluda muy efusiva a Lupita. Font sorprende a Sol insinuándosele al profesor Gonzalo; Alicia encuentra en el escritorio de Font fotografías de varias adolescentes; Sol golpea a Mía con un balón; Sol se enfurece al ver a Mía con Miguel.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta le dice a Mía y a Miguel que le preocupa el futuro de RBD. Hilda y Alicia sospechan que Font no es una persona honesta. Teo le comenta a José que la quiere, pero siente que lo asfixia. Tomás le dice a Roger que le enseñará algo de Roberta.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Tomás pretende mostrarle a Roger una grabación, pero José le roba el casete; Mía y Miguel planean que Roberta y Diego se reconcilien; Roberta se entera de que Roger está enfermo; Roger finge un ataque al corazón cuando Roberta termina con él.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Font acepta que Santos realice un documental del colegio; Sol logra que despidan a Mayra por recriminarle su acoso al profesor Gonzalo; los alumnos se quejan de las injusticias del director; Lola obliga a Sol a pedirle perdón a Lupita.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: El director les anuncia a los estudiantes que el profesor Gonzalo ha sido despedido del colegio por traspasar los vínculos entre docente y estudiante.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Miguel siente celos al ver a Mía con Gastón. El director Font ve a Sol en bikini e intenta besarla. Alma le ofrece a Mayra ser su asistente. Mía planea ayudar a Alma en su show junto a RBD.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: El padre de Diego habla con él pidiéndole que no ayude a Alma, ya que ahora su carrera política está en lo alto, mientras que el director es despedido.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Leonardo quiere ser novio de Lupita, pero Lola piensa que es con ella con quien quiere andar; el señor Mendiola les informa a los alumnos que el nuevo director del colegio es Pascual; Miguel se enoja con Mía por salir con Gastón y mentirle.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: León ensucia el agua del colegio para poder comprarlo. Roger se hace el enfermo para que Roberta lo cuide.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Quieren cerrar el colegio porque los inspectores determinan que las instalaciones no están en condiciones óptimas. Lola se lanza a los brazos de Leo y lo besa delante de Lupita. RBD actúa como grupo coreográfico de Alma, ocultos tras una máscara.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Pascual se siente un hombre afortunado; Lola insulta a Leonardo al saber que no está interesado en ella; Mía acepta dejar de ser amiga de Gastón; León le dice a Diego que es socio de la Elite; Gastón, al ver a Mía, finge que Miguel lo golpea.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía le promete a Miguel alejarse de Gastón. Lupita le pide a Teo que finja que son novios, pero José los sorprende. Roberta y Diego se postulan a la presidencia de la sociedad de alumnos. Miguel es atacado por un par de matones.
programme.sub-title: No todo es lo que parece

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Alicia le hace brujería a Pascual. Roberta y Diego preparan sus campañas para la presidencia. Lola descubre a José y Teo besándose y piensa que están engañando a Lupita. Mía tiene un mal presentimiento sobre una carta dejada por Miguel.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: La carta de Miguel deprime a Mía y Gastón aprovecha para acercarse a ella. Lola amenaza a Teo por engañar a Lupita. Roberta enfrenta a Diego por su campaña desleal. Después de ver a Leo besar a Lupita, Lola la abofetea y la llama mentirosa.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Diego pide a Iñaki que se infiltre en el equipo de campaña de Roberta. Los secuestradores se ponen en contacto con Mía para pedir un rescate por Miguel. Lupita se distancia de Leo e intenta arreglar las cosas con Lola, pero esta la desprecia.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta le pide a Lola que le dé otra oportunidad a Lupita. Diego le pide consejo a León para ganar las elecciones. Mía no consigue reunir la cantidad solicitada por los captores, pero Franco llega con el dinero y se disponen a rescatar a Miguel.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Guillermo quiere romper con Fátima y le pide ayuda a Alma. Lola ofrece su apoyo a Diego a cambio de correr a Lupita de la escuela. Franco y Mía entregan el rescate. Gastón es el autor intelectual del secuestro de Miguel.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Don Arnoldo puede morir en cualquier momento y la familia López lo complace en todo lo que quiera. Pero el abuelo se entera de que su diagnóstico fue erróneo y no está dispuesto a renunciar a todas las atenciones que recibe.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Plácido echa a Don Arnoldo de la casa después de enterarse de que lo de su enfermedad era una mentira. Don Arnoldo desaparece, Plácido se siente muy mal por haberlo tratado así y recuerda los momentos que pasaron juntos.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Justo accede a que Gaby y Plutarco se casen, pero todo lo que pague de la boda se lo descontará a Plácido de su sueldo. Pero, ellos se enfadan y los López los ayudarán a reconciliarse y no quedar mal con Justo.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Don Justo le obsequia a Plutarco unas argollas de matrimonio, pero las pierde. Plácido reprocha a su familia, su comportamiento en la boda de Plutarco y Gaby. En la luna de miel, a Plutarco le ocurre un accidente.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Los López preparan una fiesta sorpresa para La Nena. Carlos, el papá de La Nena reaparece inesperadamente y le cuenta cómo ha sido su vida.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Martina tiene su primer novio, pero las cosas se salen de control cuando se inventa una vida que no tiene y a su vez, él también tiene un secreto que no se imaginan.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Al tratar de arreglar la antena de la televisión, un rayo cae sobre los López, provocando que todos cambien de personalidad. Renata le pide ayuda a una curandera y Plácido descubre que todo era un sueño.

programme.desc: Martina escucha que La Nena tiene novio y la chantajea con decirle a la familia si no obedece sus órdenes. Cansada de los abusos decide hablar con la familia.

programme.desc: Lichita lleva semanas sin hablarle a la Nena porque tiene novio y le exige que termine su relación. Renata propone que hagan una comida para que puedan conocer al novio de la Nena.

programme.desc: Los López se preocupan porque la nueva dueña del edificio correrá a las familias que excedan de cuatro integrantes. Plácido le explica el porqué son 10.

At the same time, Katniss also learns about a secret rebellion spreading throughout all of Panem -- a rebellion that will place her at the center of a plot to turn the tables on Snow.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 2

programme.title: Den of Thieves
programme.desc: Nick O'Brien is the hard-drinking leader of the Regulators, an elite unit of the Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department. Ray Merrimen is the recently paroled leader of the Outlaws, a gang of ex-military men who use their expertise and tactical skills to evade the law. O'Brien, Merrimen and their crews soon find themselves on a direct collision course as the criminals hatch an elaborate plan for a seemingly impossible heist -- the city's Federal Reserve Bank.

programme.title: Plane
programme.desc: Pilot Brodie Torrance saves passengers from a lightning strike by making a risky landing on a war-torn island -- only to find that surviving the landing was just the beginning. When dangerous rebels take most of the passengers hostage, the only person Torrance can count on for help is Louis Gaspare, an accused murderer who was being transported by the FBI.

programme.title: Law Abiding Citizen
programme.desc: Clyde Shelton is an honorable family man, until the day his wife and daughter are murdered in a home invasion. He hopes for justice, but a rising prosecutor named Nick Rice cuts a deal with one of the killers in exchange for testimony. Ten years later, that man is found dead.

programme.title: Snitch
programme.desc: At 18 years old, Jason receives a mandatory 10-year prison sentence after being caught with a package that contained illegal drugs, although he was unaware of its contents. His father, businessman John Matthews (Dwayne Johnson), is devastated. When Jason turns down a chance to lessen his sentence by manufacturing evidence to implicate someone else, John begs to be sent undercover instead, but the already dangerous venture turns deadly after he exposes a major player in the Mexican drug trade.

programme.title: Escape Plan
programme.desc: Tough and chiseled Ray Breslin (Sylvester Stallone) knows how to infiltrate a prison -- and bust out of one. His latest job leads to a double-cross, leaving him stuck in a high-tech facility with the worst that society has to offer. Luckily for Ray, he meets Emil Rottmayer (Arnold Schwarzenegger), an inmate who secretly helps him hatch a plot to win his freedom. Only sadistic warden Hobbes (Jim Caviezel) stands in the way of the two men successfully making it out alive.

programme.title: Escape Plan 2: Hades
programme.desc: Ray Breslin manages an elite team of security specialists trained in the art of breaking people out of the world's most impenetrable prisons. When his trusted operative, Shu Ren, is kidnapped and disappears inside the most elaborate prison ever built, Ray assembles an elite team to assist in the rescue.

programme.title: Bent
programme.desc: A discredited former cop connects a murder case to an elaborate conspiracy involving high-stakes treason.

programme.title: Destroyer
programme.desc: As a young cop, Erin Bell went undercover to infiltrate a gang in the California desert -- with tragic results. Bell continues to work as a detective for the Los Angeles Police Department, but feelings of anger and remorse leave her worn-down and consumed by guilt. When the leader of that gang suddenly re-emerges, Erin embarks on an obsessive quest to find his former associates, bring him to justice and make peace with her tortured past.

programme.title: Kill Bill: Vol. 1
programme.desc: A former assassin, known simply as The Bride (Uma Thurman), wakes from a coma four years after her jealous ex-lover Bill (David Carradine) attempts to murder her on her wedding day. Fueled by an insatiable desire for revenge, she vows to get even with every person who contributed to the loss of her unborn child, her entire wedding party, and four years of her life. After devising a hit list, The Bride sets off on her quest, enduring unspeakable injury and unscrupulous enemies.

programme.title: Kill Bill: Vol. 2
programme.desc: The Bride (Uma Thurman) picks up where she left off in volume one with her quest to finish the hit list she has composed of all the people who have wronged her, including ex-boyfriend Bill (David Carradine), who tried to have her killed four years ago during her wedding to another man. Leaving several dead in her wake, she eventually tracks down Bill in Mexico. Using skills she has learned during her assassin career, she attempts to finish what she set out to do in the first place.
