programme.desc: A small-town sheriff, Brent Marken (Michael Biehn), discovers the presence of a serial killer in his sleepy hamlet. Since the perpetrator has been targeting only virgins, both male and female, the deaths cause panic in much of the local high school population. Sheriff Marken's daughter, Jody (Brittany Murphy), is among the potential victims, since she has yet to sleep with her boyfriend, Kenny Ascott (Gabriel Mann). Can the lawman stop the killer before he goes after Jody?

programme.title: Cry Wolf
programme.desc: Mysterious murders occur when students (Lindy Booth, Julian Morris) at a prep school invent a story about a serial killer.

programme.title: Cucuy: The Boogeyman
programme.desc: A teenage girl under house arrest discovers that the nightmarish urban legend of the Mexican boogeyman, El Cucuy, is true.

programme.title: The Darkness
programme.desc: Peter Taylor (Kevin Bacon), his wife Bronny and their two children return to Los Angeles after a fun-filled vacation to the Grand Canyon. Strange events soon start to plague the family, including young son Michael's increasingly erratic behavior. The Taylors learn that Michael brought back some mysterious rocks that he discovered inside a cave. Unfortunately, something followed them home as the clan now find themselves in a battle with a supernatural force that preys on their worst fears.

programme.title: Dead in the Water
programme.desc: An all-female crew, on a boat in the middle of nowhere, must deal with an invader on their ship.

programme.title: Dead Man's Eyes
programme.desc: Blinded by acid thanks to his jealous model, an artist (Lon Chaney) needs eye tissue for an operation.

programme.title: Delirium
programme.desc: A man inherits a haunted house after spending time in a mental institution.

programme.title: Dementia 13
programme.desc: A mysterious masked killer terrorizes members of a family at a secluded estate.

programme.title: The Forest
programme.desc: When her twin sister disappears in Japan, a young American named Sara becomes determined to find out what happened to her. Sara's investigation leads her to the legendary Aokigahara Forest, located at the base of Mount Fuji. Accompanied by expatriate Aiden, she enters the mysterious wilderness after being warned to "stay on the path." Her investigation plunges her into a dark world where the angry and tormented souls of the dead prey on those who dare to explore the forest.

programme.title: Games
programme.desc: Wealthy and bored, Paul (James Caan) and Jennifer Montgomery (Katharine Ross) while away their hours in a New York City apartment filled with pinball machines and other amusements. The couple's routine is upended when door-to-door saleswoman Lisa Schindler (Simone Signoret) drops by and is suddenly taken ill. The Montgomerys let her spend the night. And soon, the sophisticated Lisa and her hosts embark on a new set of very adult -- and very dangerous -- games.

programme.title: Gone
programme.desc: After decades of living on the run, murder suspect Frank O'Neal (Billy Burke) returns to Los Angeles hoping to put his derailed existence back on track. O'Neal reconnects with an old flame, Karen Mellor (Sherry Stringfield), and finds gainful employment as a driver for an armored truck service. But, as he falls under the influence of a maniacal televangelist (Gregory Itzin), the unsavory impulses behind O'Neal's return begin to surface, threatening to destroy him.

programme.title: The Green Inferno
programme.desc: New York college student Justine (Lorenza Izzo), a lawyer's daughter, meets a student activist named Alejandro (Ariel Levy) when he goes on a hunger strike on behalf of underpaid janitors. Smitten, Justine agrees to help Alejandro undertake his next project: to save the Amazon. She soon learns to regret her decision when their plane crashes in the Peruvian jungle and she and the rest of their group are taken captive by a tribe of hungry cannibals.

programme.title: The Guardian
programme.desc: Optimistic about their future, well-off parents Kate (Carey Lowell) and Phil (Dwier Brown) hire the pleasant and lovely young Camilla (Jenny Seagrove) to live with them and care for their new baby. Though Camilla seems like an answer to their prayers, she proves to be more than she appears, and a diabolical plot involving the wellbeing of their child is uncovered. The young parents are forced to fight supernatural forces for the life of their vulnerable offspring.

programme.title: I Saw What You Did
programme.desc: Kit (Sarah Lane) and her best friend, Libby (Andi Garrett), are two teenage girls bored while baby-sitting. To pass the time, they make prank phone calls, telling the person on the other end of the line, "I saw what you did, and I know who you are!" It's all in good fun, until they call a man (John Ireland) who just murdered his wife and buried her in the woods. Convinced they actually do know his secret, he becomes determined to find out who they are and silence them forever.

programme.title: Incarnate
programme.desc: After a single mother witnesses terrifying symptoms of demonic possession in her 11-year-old son (David Mazouz), a Vatican representative calls on wheelchair-bound scientist Dr. Seth Ember (Aaron Eckhart) to rid him of the evil spirit. Driven by a personal agenda rooted in his own tragic past, Ember enters the boy's unconscious mind where he confronts a demon as ferocious as it is ingenious.

programme.title: The Keeping Hours
programme.desc: A lawyer sees the ghost of his dead son, which leads the man's estranged wife back into his life.

programme.title: Killer High
programme.desc: Sabrina's perfectly planned high school reunion goes south when a monster keeps killing all the guests.

programme.title: Boogeyman
programme.desc: Mike (Eddie McClintock), the town sheriff, has to battle the mythical Boogeyman after boys accidentally release it.

programme.title: Long Time Dead
programme.desc: After a long night of dancing and drinking their way into a haze, roommates Rob (Joe Absolom), Liam (Alec Newman), Stella (Lara Belmont) and Spencer (James Hillier) and a few of their friends duck into a back room of the nightclub to play around with a Ouija board. None of the friends like what the board tells them: they will all die that night. Sure enough, one by one the young friends are slaughtered by a malevolent killer, amid revelations about satanic worship and sacrifice.

programme.title: The New Daughter
programme.desc: A single father (Kevin Costner) is puzzled by his daughter's (Ivana Baquero) weird behavior, which begins soon after he moves his family to a secluded woodland home.

programme.title: Nightmare

programme.title: Not Safe for Work

programme.title: Phantasm II
programme.desc: Years after surviving his encounter with the sinister Tall Man (Angus Scrimm), Mike Pearson (James LeGros), now a mental patient, still has nightmares about the evil gaunt mortician. Upon being released from the institution, Mike and his friend Reggie (Reggie Bannister) set out to track down the Tall Man and end his murderous and macabre practices. Also involved is Liz Reynolds (Paula Irvine), a pretty young woman who has a psychic connection to both Mike and the Tall Man.

programme.title: Rosewood Lane

programme.title: Saint Ange
programme.desc: Anna is a cleaning woman who accepts a post at the St. Ange Orphanage. She arrives to confront an unsettling lack of orphans, save for one who acts far too childish for her age. Then the bizarre sights and sounds begin, which seem to elude detection by the only other servant or the gloomy institution's director. Is this all in Anna's mind? Or does something more sinister lurk in the heart of St. Ange?

programme.title: Heist
programme.desc: When their attempt to rob a gangster's (Robert De Niro) casino goes awry, a desperate man (Jeffrey Dean Morgan) and his partner (Dave Bautista) hijack a city bus to escape from the police and a maniacal thug (Morris Chestnut).

programme.title: Cash Out
programme.desc: Tempted by what could be his biggest score ever, professional thief Mason joins forces with his younger brother to rob a bank. However, when the heist goes awry, the thieves find themselves trapped inside, surrounded by SWAT teams, the FBI and Interpol. Things get even more tense when Mason eventually talks to the lead negotiator -- his former lover.

programme.title: Confidence
programme.desc: In this glossy neo-noir caper, expert grifter Jake Vig (Edward Burns) inadvertently crosses volatile crime boss the King (Dustin Hoffman) and, to make it right, he must agree to con banker Morgan Price (Robert Forster). He assembles his team, including Lily (Rachel Weisz) and Gordo (Paul Giamatti), but things get complicated fast with the arrival of Special Agent Gunther Butan (Andy Garcia), who has been tracking Jake for years. As the con goes down, Jake can't say who's double-crossing whom.

programme.title: Force of Nature
programme.desc: A policeman and a former cop battle a gang of thieves as they search for $55 million inside an evacuated building during a hurricane.

programme.title: Man on a Ledge
programme.desc: When disgraced ex-cop Nick Cassidy (Sam Worthington) steps onto the ledge of the highest floor of New York's famous Roosevelt Hotel, more than just his life is at risk; he threatens to bring the city to its knees. There are some very nervous people around with some very big secrets to hide. As police negotiator Lydia Spencer (Elizabeth Banks) tries to talk Nick in from the ledge, she begins to suspect that he has an ulterior motive behind his actions.

programme.title: Den of Thieves
programme.desc: Nick O'Brien is the hard-drinking leader of the Regulators, an elite unit of the Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department. Ray Merrimen is the recently paroled leader of the Outlaws, a gang of ex-military men who use their expertise and tactical skills to evade the law. O'Brien, Merrimen and their crews soon find themselves on a direct collision course as the criminals hatch an elaborate plan for a seemingly impossible heist -- the city's Federal Reserve Bank.

programme.title: The Expendables
programme.desc: Mercenary leader Barney Ross and his loyal men take on what they think is a routine assignment: a covert operation to invade the South American country of Vilena and overthrow its dictator. But, when they learn that the job will be a suicide mission, they must choose redemption or the destruction of their brotherhood.

programme.title: The Expendables 2
programme.desc: Mercenary leader Barney Ross (Sylvester Stallone), Lee Christmas (Jason Statham) and the rest of the Expendables team reunite when Mr. Church (Bruce Willis) hires them for a seemingly easy job. But things go terribly wrong, compelling the mercenaries to seek revenge for a comrade's murder. With the odds against them, Barney and his team are hell-bent on payback and cut a path of destruction through opposing forces, only to encounter an unexpected threat: six pounds of weapons-grade plutonium.

programme.title: The Expendables 3
programme.desc: Years ago, Barney Ross co-founded the Expendables with Conrad Stonebanks. After Stonebanks became an arms dealer, Ross was forced to kill him -- or so he thought. Now, Stonebanks is back, and he's on a mission to end the Expendables. Ross decides that the way to fight old blood is with new blood, so he assembles a team of younger, faster, more tech-savvy recruits. The battle to topple Stonebanks becomes a clash of old-school methods vs. high-tech expertise.

programme.title: The Expendables 4
programme.desc: Armed with every weapon they can get their hands on, the Expendables are the world's last line of defense and the team that gets called when all other options are off the table.

programme.title: Conan the Barbarian
programme.desc: A powerful Cimmerian warrior, Conan carves a bloody path across the land of Hyboria on a personal vendetta. That soon turns into an epic battle against evil, for Conan's mortal enemy, Khalar Zym, seeks the legendary Mask of Acheron. The artifact will enable Khalar Zym to raise his wife from the dead and achieve immortality for himself, but it will also unleash a malevolent force upon the land, and only Conan and his companions can stop it.

programme.title: Gods of Egypt
programme.desc: The survival of mankind hangs in the balance when Set, the merciless god of darkness, usurps Egypt's throne and plunges the prosperous empire into chaos and conflict. Hoping to save the world and rescue his true love, a defiant mortal named Bek forms an unlikely alliance with the powerful god Horus. Their battle against Set and his henchmen takes them into the afterlife and across the heavens for an epic confrontation.

programme.title: The Last Witch Hunter
programme.desc: The modern world holds many secrets, the most astounding being that witches still live among us. Centuries ago, Kaulder managed to slay the all-powerful Witch Queen, decimating her followers in the process. Before her death, she cursed the valiant warrior with her own immortality, separating him from his beloved wife and daughter in the afterlife. Her resurrection now threatens the survival of the human race as Kaulder, the only one of his kind remaining, faces her vengeful wrath.

programme.title: The Legend of Hercules
programme.desc: As the son of Zeus, king of the gods, and a mortal woman, Hercules (Kellan Lutz) is blessed with extraordinary strength. Caught in a forbidden love, Hercules is exiled by his stepfather, the king, and sold into slavery. The legendary strongman endures harrowing battles and death matches in the gladiators' arena, and must use his formidable powers to fight his way back to his rightful kingdom, overthrow its traitorous ruler and restore peace to the land.

programme.title: Snowpiercer
programme.desc: A post-apocalyptic ice age forces humanity's last survivors aboard a globe-spanning supertrain. One man will risk everything to lead a revolt for control of the engine and the future of the world.

programme.desc: A military experiment to harness unlimited energy goes horribly awry, leaving a pilot with no choice but to fight through an imploding world to save his family and the planet itself.

programme.title: Knowing
programme.desc: Fifty years after it was buried in a time capsule, a schoolgirl's cryptic document falls into the hands of Caleb Koestler, the son of professor John Koestler (Nicolas Cage). John figures out that the encoded message accurately lists every major disaster from the past five decades, and predicts three future calamities -- one a global cataclysm. When his warnings fall on deaf ears, John enlists the help of the prophetic author's daughter and granddaughter to try to avert the ultimate disaster.

programme.title: Kin
programme.desc: While scavenging for copper wire, Detroit teenager Eli Solinski stumbles upon a high-tech gun that holds special powers. When his brother, Jimmy, lands in trouble with a local crime boss, the two siblings take the mysterious weapon and go on the run. Eli and Jimmy now find themselves in a life-and-death battle against an army of thugs and two heavily armored, futuristic soldiers who want their gun back.

programme.title: The Giver
programme.desc: Jonas (Brenton Thwaites) lives in a seemingly idyllic world of conformity and contentment. When he begins to spend time with The Giver (Jeff Bridges), an old man who is the sole keeper of the community's memories, Jonas discovers the dangerous truths of his community's secret past. Armed with the power of knowledge, Jonas realizes that he must escape from their world to protect himself and those he loves -- a challenge no one has ever completed successfully.

programme.title: La trenza
programme.desc: Un pueblo confundido por la religión, persigue a una mujer que robó la trenza de la estatua de la Virgen.

programme.title: Más negro que la noche
programme.desc: Tres hermosas mujeres se trasladan a una vieja casona, heredada por la tía de una de ellas, y presencian cosas extrañas.

programme.title: El extensionista
programme.desc: Un ingeniero va a enseñar a los campesinos a mejorar sus cultivos y descubre la gran opresión del cacique del pueblo.

programme.title: Hasta el viento tiene miedo
programme.desc: Un espíritu vengativo se apodera de una joven suicida en un centro de tratamientos. Sucesos misteriosos del pasado atormentan el presente.

programme.title: Cuentos colorados
programme.desc: Las aventuras ocurren en una casa de citas muy lujosa, pero el dueño no lo confiesa su profesión a su tía.

programme.title: Escape Sangriento
programme.desc: Con la ayuda de sus cómplices, un narcotraficante planea un peligroso escape de prisión.

programme.title: Mi nombre es Gatillo
programme.desc: Un hombre llamado el "Gatillo" solo tiene violencia en su sangre y su vida está controlada por las armas.

programme.title: El cachas de oro
programme.desc: Un conocido juez persigue a unos violadores y asesinos, hijos de Ramsés, y los mete a la cárcel, pero su padre los libera, por lo que el valiente juez se ve obligado a matarlos. Ramsés se vengará del juez matando a su prometida.

programme.title: Muertes anunciadas
programme.desc: Un niño busca venganza por la muerte brutal de toda su familia, a manos de una banda de asesinos.

programme.title: Mujer de Cabaret
programme.desc: La hermosa y popular cantante de un club nocturno es condenada injustamente por un asesinato.

programme.title: Pasiones Infernales
programme.desc: Una mujer es maltratada por las mujeres de su aldea por el solo hecho de ser de color.

programme.title: El Payo: un hombre contra el mundo
programme.desc: El Payo protege a su familia del bajo mundo del crimen, el cual quiere robarle su vida y su integridad.

programme.title: Condenados a Duelo
programme.desc: Dos hombres no se detendrán ante nada hasta cobrar venganza con la sangre del culpable.

programme.title: Los Humillados
programme.desc: Dos hermanos, uno compositor y el otro cantante, van a probar fama y fortuna a la capital.

programme.title: Las sobrinas del Diablo
programme.desc: Un cacique asesina al propietario de unas tierras y a su mujer para adueñarse de ellas. El criminal no contaba con que las hijas habían escapado y tratarán de vengarse con la ayuda del Diablo, quien las cuidó desde pequeñas.

programme.title: La hija sin padre
programme.desc: Una joven cantante se enamora de un hombre y se casa, pero este niega ser el padre de la criatura que ella espera.

programme.title: Por el Poder de la Mara
programme.desc: Un grupo de mafiosos desata una guerra cuando la esposa de un personaje clave para su organización es secuestrada.

programme.title: El rey de los albures
programme.desc: Un vendedor de tacos famoso por sus chistes participa en un concurso de baile con su ahijada para poder pagar una deuda.

programme.title: Acapulqueña
programme.desc: Un millonario decide montar un espectáculo con una mujer de Acapulco y dos hombres se enamoran de ella.

programme.title: Santo: Infraterrestre
programme.desc: Las fuerzas del bien se enfrentan a las malévolas intenciones de los Infraterrestres, seres de otro planeta que intentarán apoderarse de la Tierra.

programme.title: Adiós, New York, adiós
programme.desc: La ciudad de Nueva York es el escenario donde se juntan varias historias protagonizadas por latinos. Una familia puertorriqueña, dos mexicanos y sus amigos buscan fortuna sin olvidar sus raíces y tradiciones.

programme.title: El Mofles y Canek en máscara vs cabellera
programme.desc: Un mecánico inexperto en el deporte de la lucha libre vive toda una aventura cuando se enfrenta a un luchador asesino.

programme.title: Barridos y regados
programme.desc: Cuando dos mensajeros llegan con un recado a una empresa, los confunden con los técnicos a los que esperaban y ellos aprovechan la situación para ganar dinero e impresionar a las bellas secretarias.

programme.title: Mágico, el Enviado de los Dioses
programme.desc: Un héroe enmascarado llamado Mágico llega a la Tierra para pelear contra una fuerza maléfica y defender a los necesitados.

programme.title: La hora del jaguar
programme.desc: Como agente de la policía se caracterizó por ser el más despiadado, ahora retirado, se convierte en asesino a sueldo.

programme.title: Observing Europe-Europe's heating up: So where is the AC?
programme.desc: CGTN reporter Li Jianhua reports on how Londoners live without air conditioning, despite the British summers getting longer and heater.

programme.title: Observing Europe-So many UK Prime Ministers, same old problems
programme.desc: Since moving to London, CGTN's Li Jianhua has witnessed the UK cycle through four leaders. \nIn this video, Jianhua reflects on the problems facing each of those prime ministers… and why it's affected how he buys grapes.

programme.title: Observing Europe-Who owns Britain?
programme.desc:
One of the first things that surprised CGTN's Li Jianhua after moving to Britain was discovering that London’s iconic black cabs are made by a subsidiary of China’s Geely. 
It’s not alone. Jaguar Land Rover belongs to India’s Tata, Mini is owned by Germany’s BMW, and many of Britain’s airports, utilities and landmark buildings have foreign owners. 
For decades, Britain embraced global investment. But the battle over British Steel suggests attitudes are changing. As concerns grow around national security and economic resilience, the question is no longer just who invests in Britain — but which industries are too strategic to be foreign-owned. 
In this latest episode of his series Observing Europe, Jianhua explores ownership, investment – and where Britain is drawing the line.

programme.title: Observing Europe - Is migration \"weaponized\" in Europe?
programme.desc: Schengen - one of Europe’s greatest achievements - is being tested.\nThe Schengen Area promised border-free travel across much of Europe. But migration, security concerns and increasingly polarized politics are putting that promise under pressure.\nFrom Ceuta to the return of internal border checks, CGTN Europe correspondent Li Jianhua looks at how Europe’s migration debate is reshaping Schengen — and asks: Can Europe keep its internal borders open as political pressure to control migration grows.

programme.title: BizTalk | AI-powered travel reshaping global tourism
programme.desc: China’s tourism market has continued to heat up this summer. Behind this boom, artificial intelligence (AI) is changing how people travel and is opening up new opportunities for the industry – from personalized itineraries to immersive experiences.\n\nIn this episode of BizTalk, guests from the World Economic Forum, the World Travel & Tourism Council and Atout France explore how smart technologies can enhance visitor experiences, optimize destination management and unlock new growth opportunities. They also examine what China's emerging \"AI tourism\" focus could offer the global tourism industry.

programme.title: Global Business-Asian Edition Ep.2
programme.desc: Global Business is the flagship business show of CGTN English Channel, bringing you the latest economic data, business trends and policies.

programme.title: Meet China: When Chinese Dynamism Reshapes Landscapes — Boundless Challenges, Infinite Vitality
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, we journey from the cloud-piercing peaks of Zhangjiajie to the tech-driven streets of Shenzhen and the cassava farms of Vietnam. We meet extreme athletes redefining personal limits, turning vertical cliffs and open skies into new playgrounds. Then, we ride in a fully autonomous robotaxi through Shenzhen traffic, exploring the technology and regulations accelerating the global race for self-driving cars. Finally, we travel to Vietnam, where Chinese investment and expertise have transformed the cassava industry—boosting yields, stabilizing farmer incomes, and creating resilient supply chains reaching global markets. From skies to roads to fields, this episode shows how China’s dynamism is reshaping landscapes and lives worldwide.

programme.title: Summer Davos 2026: The Future of Jobs, Skills, and Sustainable Growth
programme.desc:
Global trade is undergoing profound change as economies grapple with shifting supply chains, rapid advances in artificial intelligence, and the transition to cleaner energy.

We are coming to you from the Summer Davos Forum in Dalian, where policymakers, business leaders, and academics from around the world are discussing how to navigate these transformations.

One key question at this year's forum is how these changes will affect workers, and whether they will create new opportunities or deepen existing challenges. To discuss the future of jobs, skills, and sustainable growth, Song Ruixin is joined by Professor Mercedes Maroto-Valer, Deputy Principal for Global Sustainability at Heriot-Watt University, and Kathleen Alexander, co-founder and CEO of Savor, a San Jose based food startup.

programme.title: No Power, No AI
programme.desc: Is energy the ultimate bottleneck for artificial intelligence? As compute demand skyrockets, can our power grids keep up? CGTN's Michael Wang moderates a critical panel at the 2026 Summer Davos Forum on the intersection of AI and energy infrastructure. We'll explore how to align capital investment, infrastructure build-out, and policy frameworks; future-proof energy supply systems to strengthen energy security; and build a more inclusive, sustainable AI-powered energy future. Tune in as global leaders tackle the energy challenge powering the next wave of AI.\n#SummerDavos2026.

programme.desc: CGTN reporter Li Jianhua reports on how Londoners live without air conditioning, despite the British summers getting longer and heater.

programme.title: Observing Europe-So many UK Prime Ministers, same old problems
programme.desc: Since moving to London, CGTN's Li Jianhua has witnessed the UK cycle through four leaders. \nIn this video, Jianhua reflects on the problems facing each of those prime ministers… and why it's affected how he buys grapes.

programme.title: Observing Europe-Who owns Britain?
programme.desc:
One of the first things that surprised CGTN's Li Jianhua after moving to Britain was discovering that London’s iconic black cabs are made by a subsidiary of China’s Geely. 
It’s not alone. Jaguar Land Rover belongs to India’s Tata, Mini is owned by Germany’s BMW, and many of Britain’s airports, utilities and landmark buildings have foreign owners. 
For decades, Britain embraced global investment. But the battle over British Steel suggests attitudes are changing. As concerns grow around national security and economic resilience, the question is no longer just who invests in Britain — but which industries are too strategic to be foreign-owned. 
In this latest episode of his series Observing Europe, Jianhua explores ownership, investment – and where Britain is drawing the line.

programme.title: Observing Europe - Is migration \"weaponized\" in Europe?
programme.desc: Schengen - one of Europe’s greatest achievements - is being tested.\nThe Schengen Area promised border-free travel across much of Europe. But migration, security concerns and increasingly polarized politics are putting that promise under pressure.\nFrom Ceuta to the return of internal border checks, CGTN Europe correspondent Li Jianhua looks at how Europe’s migration debate is reshaping Schengen — and asks: Can Europe keep its internal borders open as political pressure to control migration grows.

programme.title: BizTalk | AI-powered travel reshaping global tourism
programme.desc: China’s tourism market has continued to heat up this summer. Behind this boom, artificial intelligence (AI) is changing how people travel and is opening up new opportunities for the industry – from personalized itineraries to immersive experiences.\n\nIn this episode of BizTalk, guests from the World Economic Forum, the World Travel & Tourism Council and Atout France explore how smart technologies can enhance visitor experiences, optimize destination management and unlock new growth opportunities. They also examine what China's emerging \"AI tourism\" focus could offer the global tourism industry.

programme.title: Meet China: When Chinese Dynamism Reshapes Landscapes — Boundless Challenges, Infinite Vitality
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, we journey from the cloud-piercing peaks of Zhangjiajie to the tech-driven streets of Shenzhen and the cassava farms of Vietnam. We meet extreme athletes redefining personal limits, turning vertical cliffs and open skies into new playgrounds. Then, we ride in a fully autonomous robotaxi through Shenzhen traffic, exploring the technology and regulations accelerating the global race for self-driving cars. Finally, we travel to Vietnam, where Chinese investment and expertise have transformed the cassava industry—boosting yields, stabilizing farmer incomes, and creating resilient supply chains reaching global markets. From skies to roads to fields, this episode shows how China’s dynamism is reshaping landscapes and lives worldwide.

programme.title: Summer Davos 2026: The Future of Jobs, Skills, and Sustainable Growth
programme.desc:
Global trade is undergoing profound change as economies grapple with shifting supply chains, rapid advances in artificial intelligence, and the transition to cleaner energy.

We are coming to you from the Summer Davos Forum in Dalian, where policymakers, business leaders, and academics from around the world are discussing how to navigate these transformations.

One key question at this year's forum is how these changes will affect workers, and whether they will create new opportunities or deepen existing challenges. To discuss the future of jobs, skills, and sustainable growth, Song Ruixin is joined by Professor Mercedes Maroto-Valer, Deputy Principal for Global Sustainability at Heriot-Watt University, and Kathleen Alexander, co-founder and CEO of Savor, a San Jose based food startup.

programme.title: No Power, No AI
programme.desc: Is energy the ultimate bottleneck for artificial intelligence? As compute demand skyrockets, can our power grids keep up? CGTN's Michael Wang moderates a critical panel at the 2026 Summer Davos Forum on the intersection of AI and energy infrastructure. We'll explore how to align capital investment, infrastructure build-out, and policy frameworks; future-proof energy supply systems to strengthen energy security; and build a more inclusive, sustainable AI-powered energy future. Tune in as global leaders tackle the energy challenge powering the next wave of AI.\n#SummerDavos2026.

programme.title: China Untapped: Suzhou
programme.desc: CGTN’s integrated media cultural and travel program \"China Untapped: Suzhou\" features industrial tourism as its core theme, complemented by Jiangnan cultural tourism. The show follows a narrative thread of a foreign host touring the city alongside an international business investor. Serving as an explorer and guide, host Alex McCutcheon leads the entire industrial tour across Suzhou. UK businessman Athan Fox, acting as a potential investor and observer, views the city through the lens of commercial inspection and identifies the core strengths and investment potential of Suzhou’s high-end manufacturing sector. The production team traveled across Suzhou’s urban districts, Taicang, Kunshan, Changshu and other areas, visiting over 30 enterprises, research institutions and cultural tourism sites. The program presents a perfect blend of robust industrial strength and the exquisite aesthetics of Jiangnan. The two perspectives complement and validate each other, enabling global audiences to learn about Suzhou’s industrial achievements and unique charm in a way that resonates with their cognitive habits.

programme.title: Young Shaolin master
programme.desc: Xu Haican is a kung fu practitioner at the Quanzhou Shaolin Temple in Fujian. The 12-year-old boy is now an expert with the sword, the nine-section chain whip, and the monkey stick after just two years of training. Xu said these weapons give him both confidence and discipline, as he must wield them safely in practice. The young Shaolin master said he hopes to learn more from his masters and carry forward the Chinese martial art.

programme.title: Valentine’s for the Pumi People
programme.desc: In this episode, we record the grand celebration of the traditional Pumi Valentine's Day in Luoguqing, Lanping County, Yunnan Province. Every year, on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month, young men and women from the local community gather on the vast meadows of Luoguqing to take part in singing and dancing activities in pursuit of marriage. During the program, the host interacts with local people of the Pumi and other ethnic groups, showcasing the traditional plateau lifestyle of the Pumi people, their distinctive firepit culture, as well as the community’s brand-new look in the new era. All these scenes unfold against the lively backdrop of the Valentine’s Day activities, fostering a warm atmosphere of ethnic solidarity.

programme.title: Foodwise: Huangshan Ep.1
programme.desc: Tianran and Hannah climb Mount.Huangshan, one of China's most famous mountains, sampling its delicate green tea and the rich flavors of Anhui cuisine, and explore the region's ancient villages and lush bamboo forests featured in the blockbuster film \"Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon\".

programme.title: Foodwise: Huangshan Ep.2
programme.desc: In Huangshan, Anhui Province, the hosts enjoy a cup of Queen Elizabeth II's favorite tea, as well as the oldest green tea to be exported Europe, and get hands on with quirky local delicacies ranging from \"word candy\" and tofu made of leaves, to the downright funky flavors of hairy tofu and stinky mandarin fish.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Wing Chun
programme.desc: Martial arts lover Kleber Battaglia is on a mission: To seek out China's kungfu masters, and learn their secrets. From explosive Wing Chun to fluid Taiji Quan, slippery Snake Style to elegant White Crane, he'll learn hidden moves and ancient techniques for defeating powerful opponents. But ?there’s more to kungfu than combat: From culture and philosophy, to wellness and insights from the natural world, Kleber will discover that contained within every kick, strike and throw, is the condensed wisdom of the ancient masters. This is Kungfu-wise.\nKleber travels to Foshan, the birthplace of Wing Chun. A practitioner of this style, he seeks out masters of two different lineages: Ip Man and Snake Style. First he visits the Ip Man lineage, based on the legendary kungfu master whose life story spawned hundreds of martial arts movies, with Bruce Lee counting among his students. With Ip Man Wing Chun, Kleber learns how to create powerful short strikes perfectly suited to fighting in Foshan’s narrow alleys. With Snake Style, he experiences unique training methods that give its practitioners superhuman flexibility, allowing them to stick to their opponents, and even fight on boats in canals.

programme.title: China Untapped: Nanjing 3
programme.desc: Join us in Nanjing’s bustling old quarter, where you can try on silk dresses worth their weight in gold, and see how traditional handicrafts have been given modern twists. We’ll feast on street snacks and local delicacies by the old Confucian Temple, before taking a pleasure cruise along Nanjing’s mother river to round off our exploration of this vibrant and historic city.

programme.desc: The hosts are in the Wuyi Mountains of Fujian Province, the birthplace of oolong tea. programme.title: China Popcast: All you need to know for traveling in China this summer
programme.desc: Traveling in China for the first time can be a little easier if you know a few things beforehand. And new China Popcast host Min Rui gets the show going with quickfire questions on the \"dos and don'ts.\.

programme.title: Brian Linden: Take me home, country roads
programme.desc: \"Since first arriving in China in 1984, Brian Linden has built a bond with the country that now spans more than four decades. For over 20 years, he has been rooted in Xizhou, a historic town in Yunnan. Drawn by Eastern culture, he arrived as an outsider but gradually became a dedicated rural builder.\nThough he has traveled to more than 120 countries, Linden ultimately chose to settle in rural southwest China. What inspired him to stay, and what China story does he hope to share with the world? Follow Linden’s journey as we explore his life in rural China.\.

programme.title: Ancient tradition in an old town takes on new life
programme.desc: The Chinese lion dance is an art form that combines acrobatics, dance, folk music and embroidery. The southern style lion dance was a staple in the ancient town of Qiantong before the costume faded in the early 20th century. However, now the tradition has been revived by some incredible talented young people from this town.

programme.title: Nature’s Bounty
programme.desc: In this episode, we start from hiking up volcanoes in Datong. There is a large volcanic cluster with over 30 cones. Then we come to the Hanging Temple – a 1,500-year-old monastery clutching at a cliff of Mount Hengshan. Join us for an adrenaline-pumping adventure.

programme.title: Valentine's with the Snake King
programme.desc: Every year on Qixi Festival (Chinese Valentine's Day), the town of Zhanghu in Nanping, Fujian Province hosts a folk custom event: the Snake King Parade. Local residents carry the statue of the Snake King from the temple, along with specially prepared pythons, and parade through the streets and alleys. Wherever the procession passes, residents and shopkeepers greet them with firecrackers and burn incense to pray, hoping to receive the unique blessing of the Snake King. This distinctive folk activity is rarely seen elsewhere across China. Taking this event as its highlight, the episode leads audiences on a deep dive into the towns and villages of northern Fujian, delivering a highly engaging and visually appealing viewing experience.

programme.title: A Magic Chinese New Year
programme.desc: During the Year‑of‑the‑Ox Spring Festival, we visited Gubei Water Town in Miyun District, Beijing. Join host He Tianran to experience an authentic northern‑style Spring Festival. We will paste paper lanterns, cut paper‑cut window decorations, watch sugar‑blowing craftsmanship and release sky lanterns. Let us embrace this blessed Year of the Ox together.

programme.desc: China's vast land features extraordinary geological diversity and climate zones. Home to 5,000 years of civilization and 1.4 billion people, it sustains the world's second-largest economy while sheltering over 2,000 nature reserves. This documentary spotlights China's natural heritage for tomorrow's possibilities.

programme.title: Taohuawu New Year's Painting
programme.desc: Taohuawu New Year woodblock prints, originating from Suzhou, are iconic symbols of Chinese folk art. These vibrant prints, traditionally displayed during Chinese New Year, depict auspicious scenes, deities, and daily life, embodying wishes for prosperity and happiness. Explore the intricate carving and printing techniques that bring these colorful cultural treasures to life.

programme.title: A Sip of Mount Wuyi
programme.desc: Wuyi rock tea, nurtured in the mineral-rich cliffs of the Wuyi Mountains, is a distinctive oolong embodying a unique \"rock rhyme\" (yan yun)—a taste of nature's harmony. More than a beverage, teas like Da Hong Pao invite mindful appreciation, reflecting centuries of tradition and a philosophy of patience in their complex roasted notes and enduring aftertaste. Discover the terroir, meticulous processing, and the spirit of Chinese tea culture within these exceptional leaves.

programme.title: The Dynasty of Oracle Bones Ep.3
programme.desc: Over 3000 years ago, inscriptions were made into the bones of oxen and the undersides of turtle shells for the purpose of divination. Broken down into six comprehensive episodes, this series will enlighten you on the Shang Dynasty when they first appeared, as well as their role in the formation of Chinese writing.

programme.title: Why'd They Wear That?
programme.desc: Clinton Kelly and Stacy London break down the costume design and fashion moments from Mike Nichols' 1988 film "Working Girl," starring Melanie Griffith, Sigourney Weaver, and Harrison Ford. The hosts explore how Ann Roth's costume choices—from Tess's working-class Staten Island attire to her polished corporate wardrobe—reflect her transformation from secretary to executive. They discuss iconic 80s trends including big hair, commuter shoes, bold eyeshadow, shoulder pads, and the evolution of her style throughout the film, analyzing how fashion serves as a character development tool.

programme.title: Why'd They Wear That?
programme.desc: Clinton Kelly and Stacy London return to discuss costume design in the three-hour action film "One Battle After Another," exploring eight key looks worn by characters including revolutionary Perfidia Beverly Hills (Teyana Taylor), Bob Ferguson (Leonardo DiCaprio), and other ensemble cast members. The hosts praise costume designer Colleen Atwood's deliberate approach to wardrobe, analyzing how choices like safety orange camouflage, a pregnant character in military gear, and carefully detailed thrift-store aesthetics serve the story without becoming distracting. The conversation examines how costume design can be both detailed and subtly supportive of character development, comparing this film's approach to other cinema styles and discussing how clothing choices communicate character archetypes and backgrounds.

programme.title: Behind the Wings
programme.desc: 2019 marked the 50th anniversary of the Apollo 11 lunar landing. This incredible milestone changed the way humanity looked at our planet and access to deep space. Join Behind the Wings host Matthew Burchette as he sits down with NASAs Gene Kranz, summarizes the amazing events leading up to Apollo 11 and uncovers the fascinating future NASA has in store for space exploration.

programme.title: Behind the Wings
programme.desc: The Beechcraft Company has been in existence for more than 88 years and has built some of the most influential aircraft in history. Join host Matthew Burchette as he dives into the history of the iconic Beechcraft 18, explores its history as the C-45 Expeditor and ventures to Centennial Airport in Englewood, Colorado to link up with the Colorado State Patrols (CSP) Aviation Section. If you are lucky, you may even get a ride in CSPs souped-up Beechcraft King Air.

programme.title: Behind the Wings
programme.desc: Wildfires are growing in intensity, and firefighting aviation is becoming increasingly crucial to saving forests and lives in Colorado and beyond. Fire aviation teams are critical, complex efforts, made up of pilots, technicians, and coordinators who work together with ground crews to put out and contain wildfires. As environmental conditions set the stage for unprecedented fire seasons, night vision goggle technology is employed for the first time, and Colorado legislatures are paying closer attention than ever to the importance of wildfires. The progress is clear, yet so much remains to be done.

programme.title: Behind the Wings
programme.desc: New fire conditions call for new firefighting methods and tools. Looking at Calfire, we learn how the largest municipal fleet of firefighting aircraft in the world has developed over time. Live data feeds revolutionize how firefighting teams understand fires and communicate during missions. Colorado gets ready to purchase its first Firehawk helicopter, and interagency teams coordinate at the local, state, and federal levels. The challenges in fighting wildfires are greater than ever, but with new methods of fighting the fires, so are the opportunities.

programme.title: Behind the Wings
programme.desc: In the 1950s, The Century Series defined an era of aviation during the Cold War, charting a metamorphosis from one era to another. Jets were in their infancy, and many milestones, including the sound barrier, loomed large. In an arms race with the Soviet Union, a rising superpower, the U.S. got to work developing a variety of impressive fighter jets, now known as the Century Series. Starting with the F-100, the first production airplane to break the sound barrier in level flight, we explore how the century series pioneered new airplane designs, including the aerodynamic coke bottle shape made famous by the F-102. The F-104, a missile with a man in it inspired a generation of pilots. The F-105 looked like a fighter but was a bomber in disguise. As a series, their legacy is evident in modern fighter jets.

programme.title: Behind the Wings
programme.desc: For nearly sixty years the Learjet came to define a new class of luxury airplane the business jet. Now, the last Learjet ever is being assembled at the Wichita-based production facility in The Aviation Capital of the World. Speaking with aviation icons past and present, we get an intimate look at a company that shaped aviation as we know it today. From its record-setting performance achievements to its outsized role in popular culture, the Learjets place in history is here to stay, long after the production lines shut down.

programme.title: Behind the Wings
programme.desc: Early Space Exploration was defined by a Space race between the United States and the Soviet Union in a quest for national bragging rights. Major milestones like the first artificial Earth satellite, landing on the moon, and eventually creating the International Space Station (ISS) in 1993. Astronauts experience a psychological sensation called The Overview Effect. The ISS marked a new focus on international collaboration in Space. On the ISS, scientists are conducting novel research that is revolutionizing our understanding of life on earth -- from monitoring air pollution to fermenting beer. With the ISS expected to shut down in the coming decades, private space stations may play a larger role in the future of space- and exploration.

programme.title: Behind the Wings
programme.desc: From cave drawings to the identification of star constellations in the night sky, the cosmos has fascinated humankind. Space exploration also provides a unique vantage to look back at Earth. Satellite sensing enables new discoveries about climate change, natural disasters, and civilization. Researchers high in the Rocky Mountains are using satellites, and more than 50 different sensor types to create prediction models of complex watersheds. Mapping technology has become an irreplaceable part of our daily lives and helps plan everything from vaccine distribution, to chimpanzee populations. With the exponential increase in satellites in recent years, comes a need for more space infrastructure, and new challenges like space debris. The opportunities in space exploration are greater than ever but for a burgeoning space economy, so are the challenges.

programme.title: "Rakete auf dem Wasser!" Action-Urlaub in Miami...
programme.desc: Jetzt geht es mit Vollspeed über Miamis Küstengewässer. Doch nicht jedem gefallen 150 km/h so gut wie Robert Geiss… Denn Ehefrau Carmen bekommt Panik. (S4 E05)

programme.title: Carmen Geiss sieht Rot! Schluss mit Camping?!
programme.desc: Robert Geiss will Action, also sollen Carmen und Töchterchen Shania mit ihm Hovercraft fahren. Leider ist das Fahrzeug ROT. Da bekommt Frau Geiss direkt Schnappatmung, denn eine Wahrsagerin hat ihr das Ende in einem ROTEN Fahrzeug prophezeit... (S4 E07)

programme.title: Splish, Splash! Wasserspaß auf Privatinsel!
programme.desc: Inselbesichtigung deluxe! Gehört diese Privatinsel bald Robert? Sein Nachbar aus Monaco hat ihm die Insel einen Tag zur "Besichtigung" überlassen – ein echtes Privileg! Die Geissens genießen die Insel ganz für sich allein. (S4 E09)

programme.title: Wildtierfütterung auf den Bahamas?!
programme.desc: Bahamas-Urlaub à la Geiss! Der Tag startet mit dem Füttern von Stachelrochen – doch dann wird es richtig wild: Haie stehen auf dem Plan! Jetzt bloß keine falsche Bewegung machen! (S4 E09)

programme.title: Jetzt wird's wild: Crocodile-Carmen und
programme.desc: Robert und Carmen Geiss erkunden die gefährlichen Everglades und wollen sich den Alligatoren und Schlangen stellen! So zumindest der Plan. Anfangs ist weit und breit nichts zu sehen, doch plötzlich sind sie von allen Seiten umzingelt! (S4 E11)

programme.title: "Weihnachtsglocken" im Moulin Rouge!
programme.desc: Während Carmen sich in Paris von den historischen Gebäuden und den Lichtern der Stadt beeindrucken lässt, träumt Robert von den leicht bekleideten Damen des „Moulin Rouge“. (S4 E12)

programme.title: Überraschung! Geheimer Kurztrip für Carmen Geiss'
programme.desc: Robert Geiss hat etwas Großes für den Geburtstag seiner Ehefrau Carmen geplant. Also heißt es: Carmen die Augen verbinden und ins Auto laden. Für seine Liebste ist ihm nämlich nichts zu teuer: Er hat sogar eine Presidential Suite gebucht! (S4 E14)

programme.title: Ciao Venezia! Carmen Geiss' Traum wird endlich wahr...
programme.desc: Carmen Geiss' Geburtstagswochenende nimmt nochmal richtig Fahrt auf! Nächste Aktivität: venezianische Masken bemalen. Während Carmen Geiss ganz filigran den Pinsel schwingt, ist Ehemann Robert Geiss nach einem kompletten Anstrich schon fertig – typisch! (S4 E15)

programme.title: Typisch Geissens! Action statt Entspannung in
programme.desc: Familie Geiss macht einen Wochenendtrip nach Saint-Tropez! Carmen Geiss freut sich auf ein entspanntes Wochenende, aber daraus wird wohl nichts. Ehemann Robert Geiss hat andere Pläne: Ein Boot ist organisiert, und es geht direkt aufs Wasser! (S5 E01)

programme.title: Robert Geiss' neue Karriere: Kart-Profi in Ischgl?!
programme.desc: Vollgas in Ischgl! Robert Geiss hat große Pläne: Beim Summer Opening im Kartfahren will er mit den Profis mithalten. Doch kaum angekommen, wird ihm klar – hier fahren echte Könner! (S5 E02)

programme.title: Party-Alarm: Davina Geiss' XXL-Geburtstag!
programme.desc: Ein richtig großer Tag für Davina Geiss! Heute wird das Geburtstagskind stolze neun Jahre alt! Für Carmen und Robert Geiss heißt das: Zeit für eine absolute Mega-Party! Eine Überraschung jagt die nächste! (S5 E04)

programme.title: Spektakulär: Bulgarien-Reise à la Robert Geiss!
programme.desc: Mit dem Helikopter fliegt die Familie ans Schwarze Meer. Bei diesem Ausblick verschlägt es sogar Carmen Geiss die Sprache! Doch nach all der Ruhe am Strand wird plötzlich der "Ballermann" von Bulgarien anvisiert. (S5 E05)

programme.title: Schock: "Wie kann man denn sowas machen?"
programme.desc: Heute steht für die Geissens eine Bootstour auf dem Programm! Robert Geiss will seinen Kindern endlich zeigen, wie man einen Fisch angelt. Doch plötzlich hört er ein lautes Platschen und Schreie! Opa Reinhold Geiss ist ins Wasser gefallen! (S5 E07)

programme.title: Schock in Bodrum! Robert Geiss verletzt?!
programme.desc: In Bodrum gönnen sich Robert und Carmen Geiss eine wohlverdiente Auszeit. Ein riesiges Luxus-Boot darf dabei natürlich nicht fehlen. Doch die Erholung währt nicht lange – Robert hat sich verletzt! (S5 E08)

programme.title: Totalausfall: Luxus-Villa-Flop auf Ibiza?!
programme.desc: Die Geissens gönnen sich eine Auszeit auf Ibiza. Ein riesiges Luxus-Anwesen gehört dabei natürlich zum Standardprogramm… Doch es gibt ein Problem: Die Klimaanlage des Hauses funktioniert nicht! (S5 E09)

programme.title: Wer wird Ibizas next Po-Model?!
programme.desc: Es geht in die nächste Runde! Carmen und Robert Geiss unterstützen ihren Freund Walter bei einem Model-Casting. Die Models geben Vollgas und dabei wird es feuchtfröhlich! (S5 E10)

programme.title: Action auf hoher See: Robert Geiss verbannt das
programme.desc: Robert und Carmen Geiss nehmen auf Monacos Bootmesse alles genau unter die Lupe. Auf dem Wasser soll dann die Post abgehen! Doch dabei stört die Kamera! Also wird diese, samt Kamerateam, einfach vom Boot verwiesen. (S5 E11)

programme.title: Völlig crazy: Opa Geiss in High Heels?!
programme.desc: Carmen und Robert besuchen die Starnacht am Wörthersee, feiern mit Feuerwerk und einem Auftritt von Gregor Glanz. Am nächsten Tag treffen sie Fans für Autogramme und Fotos. Dann wird es peinlich, als Opa Reinhold Carmens High Heels an sich nimmt. (S5 E12)

programme.title: Nervenzusammenbruch? Ein Horrortrip für Carmen Geiss!
programme.desc: Es wird richtig wild! Die Geissens besuchen Seaworld in Orlando und Carmen Geiss muss mit Tochter Davina auf die Achterbahn. Diese entpuppt sich für Carmen als echter Horrortrip... (S5 E13)

programme.title: Robert Geiss lässt seine Frau einfach stehen?!
programme.desc: Shania Geiss' Geburtstagsparty steht an. Carmen Geiss wechselt schnell in den Designerfummel. Doch kaum ist sie fertig, düst Robert einfach los und lässt sie stehen! (S5 E13)

programme.title: Völlig benebelt in Malaysia?
programme.desc: Familie Geiss erkundet Kuala Lumpur – natürlich stilecht mit Luxus-Guide Albert. Der gebürtige Malaysier hat einiges geplant: Der erste Stopp ist ein chinesischer Tempel, wo Carmen und Davina Geiss einen geheimnisvollen Zukunftszettel ziehen. (S5 E14)

programme.title: Tempelhöhle wird zur Mutprobe!
programme.desc: Tourguide Albert hat sich für die Geissens in Kuala Lumpur etwas Besonderes überlegt: die Tempelhöhle! 👀 Doch um dort hinzugelangen, muss die Familie 272 Treppenstufen erklimmen. Carmen Geiss mit Klaustrophobie und Robert Geiss mit Höhenangst.. (S5 E15)

programme.title: Affen-Alarm: Beklaut im Paradies?!
programme.desc: Familie Geiss macht Urlaub auf Pulau Pangkor! Doch plötzlich ertönt ein lauter Schrei! Eine diebische Affenbande hat das Urlaubsdomizil entdeckt! Die Räubermannschaft schnappt sich alles, was nicht niet- und nagelfest ist. (S5 E16)

programme.title: Singapur extrem: Todesstrafe und Rikscha-Wahnsinn!
programme.desc: Die Geissens treffen sich in Singapur mit Tourguide Suzy. Zuerst soll die Metropole auf einer Bootsrundfahrt erkundet werden. Schnell kommt es zu einem äußerst heiklen Thema: Singapurs Gesetze und... die Todesstrafe! (S5 E17)

programme.title: Speedboot-Abzocke auf Barbados?!
programme.desc: Die Geissens verbringen einige Tage auf Barbados, doch statt Ruhe will Robert sofort Action. Beim geplanten Speedboot-Trip läuft vieles anders als erwartet. Seit über zehn Jahren zeigt RTLZWEI ihr Leben zwischen Luxusalltag und exklusiven Events. (S6 E02)

programme.title: Überraschung: Robert Geiss kauft heimlich ein Boot!
programme.desc: Es muss ein Boot her! Und das am besten sofort! Robert Geiss weiß auch schon ganz genau, wo er eins bekommt. Also auf zum Bootsladen. Doch Carmen Geiss traut ihren Augen kaum... wieso steht auf einem der Boote bereits Roberts Name? (S6 E03)

programme.title: Bootsdrama und heiße Cheerleader?!
programme.desc: tress pur! Robert und Carmen Geiss machen mit ihren Kindern und dem neuen Boot eine Spritztour. Doch plötzlich passiert es... Robert fährt auf eine Sandbank! Um sie herum nur Felsen und flaches Wasser. (S6 E04)

programme.title: 13-Year-Old Obsessed with VR
programme.desc: Juvenile delinquent Mikey schemes to steal church offerings, but a real thief gets there first. When the money goes missing, Mikey helps expose the deceitful Pastor, earns a reward, and uses it to help a sick child.

programme.title: Teen's First Job Goes Very Wrong
programme.desc: Teen Lamar attempts dangerous TikTok stunts to gain followers and win Lisa's attention. A near-fatal challenge lands him in the hospital, forcing him to shift his focus to mental health and genuine connection, leading to real success.

programme.title: 3 Teens Must Solve Mom's Murder Case
programme.desc: Mikey's mom, tired of her son's pranks, stages a fake murder attempt, complete with stunt doubles, a mock car explosion, and hidden cameras. The elaborate hoax is revealed as a prank for Mikey's birthday, giving him and his friends content for their new YouTube channel.

programme.title: Kid Builds Waterpark In House
programme.desc: Jay plans an epic waterpark party for Gretchen's birthday to impress her, but it gets busted by the cops. Despite the chaos, Gretchen is touched by his thoughtfulness, and they become a couple, much to their parents' amusement.

programme.title: Boy Joins Cheerleading For A Girl
programme.desc: Jay, a basketball captain, joins the cheer team to win over Madison, the cheer captain. Despite his efforts, he's benched for a basketball game. After a surprising twist in both sports, Jay confronts Madison, only to face another heartbreak.

programme.title: Kid Rigs Raffle To Win
programme.desc: Mikey, a mischievous teen, cheats in a Tesla raffle to win a car for Noah's struggling dad. His elaborate schemes unravel when his mom exposes his dishonesty, leading to a surprising twist where Noah wins, and Mikey loses his coveted Christmas gift.

programme.title: Kid Builds Secret Nightclub
programme.desc: Suspended Jay turns his hospital detention into a secret nightclub for patients, bringing joy and healing through dance. But when his mom discovers the party, Jay faces a new, unexpected "punishment" – serving his own party.

programme.title: Kid Builds Secret Tunnel To School
programme.desc: Jay, now a social media star, gets suspended, leading him to prank his new principal. His pranks backfire as a strict new principal takes over, trapping students. Jay and his friends unite, digging an escape tunnel, and restoring order to the school.

programme.title: Kid Gets World's Strictest Family
programme.desc: Sasha, a rebellious teen, is sent to her aunt and uncle's mansion for a "vacation" to learn discipline. Tricked into babysitting her conniving cousin Pearl, Sasha faces escalating pranks and blackmail, ultimately leading to a chaotic party and a shocking twist.

programme.title: Girlfriend Gives Guy Ultimatum
programme.desc: YouTuber Anas Marwah, struggling with confidence, breaks up with his unsupportive girlfriend, Morgan. He finds love and partnership with Asala, and together they build his channel into a massive success, buying the house Morgan claimed he'd never afford.

programme.title: Daughter Kicks Mom Out Of Wedding
programme.desc: Ellie struggles with her overbearing mom, Jackie, who's hijacking her wedding plans. Ellie nearly calls off the wedding, but a reconciliation with her mom, and a few surprise interventions, give Ellie the beautiful, personal day she always dreamed of.

programme.title: Nerd Scams Hot Girls On Dating Apps
programme.desc: Dayton catfishes Lilac to draw business to his mom's failing restaurant, attracting an influencer who exposes him. After his mom is hurt, Dayton apologizes in a viral TikTok, leading to Lilac's forgiveness and a flood of supportive customers.

programme.title: Guy Rejects Girl's New Personality
programme.desc: Carly pretends to be a helpless "girly girl" to win Lucas. He rejects her deceit, saying he misses the old her. Carly returns to her authentic self, and Lucas reveals he likes the real her, asking her to the dance.

programme.title: Girl Catches Guy Cheat On 4K Camera
programme.desc: Student journalist Tara investigates basketball star David's suspicious grades. She uncovers a cheating scandal orchestrated by the Principal, who's seeking revenge on his brother. Tara's exposé saves the team and exposes the truth.

programme.title: Best Friends' Double Date Goes Horribly Wrong
programme.desc: After being poisoned at a bar, Bianka wakes up with amnesia. She slowly pieces together that her best friend, Jada, spiked her drink out of jealousy. Her crush, Curtis, saved her and is rewarded with a date.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Anke Engelke als Nina, die versucht den richigen Mann fürs Leben zu finden und nur einen Macho findet, der mit Luxus prahlt. Doch Nina weiß schon, wie sie den Kerl loswird! Als Prostituierte Sugar stellt Anke fest, dass sie ihren Freier von früher kennt ... und darum will der nun nicht zahlen!

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: In Ladykracher schlüpft Anke Engelke wieder in die verschiedensten Rollen: Als Prostituierte Sugar oder Model Chantal - Anke macht immer eine gute Figur! In dieser Folge kommt auch endlich heraus, wie Ronald McDonald privat tickt und wie er seinen Feierabend verbringt.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Als Kassiererin Susi muss sich Anke Engelke in dieser Episode gegen einen Ladendieb wehren. Dabei stellt sich der Kassenscanner als echte Allzweckwaffe heraus. Darüber hinaus schafft es die 6,5-kilometer-Steherin Iris Hattendorf unerklärlicherweise ihre Konkurrentin im Stehen zu überholen!

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Meisterdiebin "Die Katze" (Anke Engelke) versucht mit allen Mitteln den großen Diamanten zu stehlen. Dabei stellt sie sich aber nicht besonders geschickt an ...! Außerdem glänzt Anke wieder in ihren Paraderollen als Sugar und Notärztin Tanja.

programme.title: Lakshmis Haus des Schicksals
programme.desc: Lakshmi Niwas ist ein gefühlvolles Familiendrama, das in einem traditionellen Haushalt spielt, in dem Beziehungen, Werte und Schicksal eng miteinander verbunden sind. Lakshmi ist eine starke und mitfühlende Frau, die zur emotionalen Stütze einer Familie wird, die von Liebe getragen, aber von Konflikten, Erwartungen und dem Wandel der Zeit herausgefordert wird. Während Generationen aufeinandertreffen und verborgene Wahrheiten ans Licht kommen, muss Lakshmi zwischen Pflicht, Opferbereitschaft und persönlichem Glück ihren eigenen Weg finden. Die Serie erzählt von Vertrauen, Zusammenhalt und der Bedeutung von Familie – Themen, die universell verständlich sind. Lakshmi Niwas ist eine Geschichte über Hoffnung, emotionale Bindungen und die stille Stärke einer Frau, die aus einem Haus ein Zuhause macht.

programme.title: Op´n Dörp
programme.desc: Die Vorfahren von Jürgen Soth-Igelmann, Spitzname "Deutz" wegen seiner Vorliebe für spezielle Oldtimer-Trecker, besaßen schon zu Zeit des 30-jährigen Krieges eine Schmiede in Gehrde. Auch Werner Böse hat das Geschäft vom Vater übernommen, der es wiederum von seinem Vater geerbt hat. Mit seinem rollenden "Tante Emma-Laden" fährt er über Land und versorgt die Dorfbewohner, die nicht in den umliegenden Orten einkaufen wollen oder können.

programme.title: Bauern in Europa
programme.sub-title: Von Schafen, Bakterien und anderen Mitarbeitern
programme.desc: Der gelernte Theologe Norbert Fischer führt mit Frau Berit und drei Kindern einen Bauernhof, der mit zwei Schafen begann und heute 120 zählt. Weil der gepachtete Hof zu klein wurde, wagte die Familie den Neuanfang mit einem hochmodernen Öko-Hof. Das fehlende Eigenkapital brachten private Geldgeber aus dem Kundenkreis auf, ihre Zinsen erhalten sie in Form von Käse.

programme.title: GEO Reportage
programme.desc: Auf Sardinien lebt eine uralte Tradition fort: die Verarbeitung der seltenen Muschelseide zu kostbaren Altartüchern. Trotz des Verschwindens der Pinna-Muscheln halten zwei Schwestern an dem filigranen Handwerk fest. Ein Fest der Erinnerung – mit goldenen Fäden aus dem Meer.

programme.title: Italien, meine Liebe
programme.desc: Sardinien ist die zweitgrößte Insel Italiens und vor allem berühmt für ihre Traumstrände. Die Langustenfischer sind leidenschaftliche Gegner von Schleppnetzen und zeigen, wie nachhaltiges Langustenfischen funktioniert. In Tinnura, nahe dem Ort Bosa, lebt Pina Monne. Sie ist Muralistin, eine Künstlerin, die die Geschichte der Sarden auf Häuserwände malt. Im Nordwesten Sardiniens leben die einzigartigen weißen Esel, die nur auf der kleinen vorgelagerten Insel Asinara vorkommen. Ein Tierarzt betreut die Esel im Nationalpark regelmäßig. Auf den Weiden von Narbolia und Montiferru werden rote Rinder gezüchtet, aus deren Milch der traditionelle Käse, der Casizolu, hergestellt wird. Die Kräuter, die hier wachsen, geben dem Käse seine unverwechselbare Note. Tiere und Käse haben ein Slow-Food-Siegel...

programme.title: Traumrouten der Schweiz
programme.sub-title: Mit dem Postauto über den Gotthardpass
programme.desc: Eine nostalgische Reise über den Gotthardpass: Mit einem Oldtimer-Postauto aus dem Jahr 1954 wollen Domenico und Maura eine Jubiläumsfahrt wagen – vorbei an Mythen, Schluchten und der sagenumwobenen Teufelsbrücke. Während sich Kletterer am steilen Fels und dickem Nebel messen, zieht auch eine historische Postkutsche samt Freiberger-Pferd ihre Runden. Und hoch oben kümmern sich drei rüstigen Brüder um den Vier-Quellen-Weg, der Rhein, Rhone, Reuß und Ticino verbindet – trotz Felsstürzen und Klimawandel. Ein faszinierender Mix aus Technikgeschichte, Naturerlebnis und gelebter Schweizer Tradition.
